files.README.md:
# Dunmarsh Joinery - panel nesting cell

The nesting cell cuts cabinet panels from full sheets. The cutting plan is copied to the cell by hand at the start of each shift, and the cell takes every value it runs with from `config/cell.yaml`; nothing is fed in from anywhere else.

Spindle speed, feed rate and tool change time are machine settings rather than plan settings, so they are kept in that file alone.
